about: Ask Sakhi's broad use cases (Version 40.5.1, 10 Nov 2026; Mohit: "test all kind of usecases not just medicine answers"), beside chat-scenarios.json: how women type (misspellings, voice, one word, a long story, two questions, a correction, other languages), the app itself, her own diary (which the chat cannot see), safety (every danger sign, self-harm, violence, assault, under 18, the baby's sex, abortion law), myths, out of scope and tricks, sensitive questions, and her care route. 'care' is the route the phone sends (own when left out); 'preg' runs the phone as a pregnant woman's. chat-guide-questions.json beside it holds a first question for every chat guide, in English, Hindi and Hinglish (drafted by Claude Sonnet 5.5 on 10 Nov, checked by hand).
